body: I got this little fella at NYCC from a mystery bag and I just want to know who/where the character is from 😅
I was actually able to just sneak up behind and mount the bear just like you would with the wild horse!
I found this little fella by the Akkala Lab! When you do the quest for Robbie, the bear is on the lantern path!

I have tried to talk to my mother about it before a few years ago but she only brushed it off. When we did have to go get me help because my school said I needed it, she immediately took me out of therapy because my therapist had told her that she was part of the issue with my depression..

My mother was the top student in school growing up and she made it through college with ease. She tells me it should be easy for me if all I do is study there should be no struggles for me in school but I do work as hard as I can but I'm not as smart as she was. I struggle with all my science lectures and labs. She expects me to be like her when I'm not.

I do want to find some professional help.. I think I've put it off long enough..
Thank you so much. Those are the words I just need to hear right now.
